{{External|rs|rsc=Iron Kite Shield|dw=Iron Shield}} {{Infobox Item |name = Iron kiteshield |image = [[File:Iron kiteshield.png]] |release = [[4 January]] [[2001]] |update = Runescape beta is now online! |members = No |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = Yes |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Wear, Drop |examine = A large metal shield. |value = 238 |weight = 5.443 |respawn = 100 |exchange = Yes |id = 1191 }} [[File:Iron kiteshield detail.png|left|130px]] The '''Iron kiteshield''' is the second-weakest smithable [[kiteshield]], requiring 1 [[Defence]] to wield. A player with 27 [[Smithing]] can make the shield by using three [[iron bar]]s on an [[anvil]] while carrying a [[hammer]], granting 75 Smithing [[experience]]. It cannot be bought from [[Cassie's Shield Shop]] for [[ironmen]], as there is no stock available. The iron kiteshield yields the highest melee defence bonuses for any shield slot item at 1 [[Defence]]. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = 0 |aslash = 0 |acrush = 0 |amagic = -8 |arange = -3 |dstab = +8 |dslash = +10 |dcrush = +9 |dmagic = -1 |drange = +9 |str = 0 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = 0 |slot = shield |image = [[File:Iron kiteshield equipped male.png|170px]] |altimage = [[File:Iron kiteshield equipped female.png|180px]] }} ==Creation== {{Recipe |skill1 = Smithing |skill1lvl = 27 |skill1boostable = Yes |skill1exp = 75 |members = No |ticks = 5 |tools = Hammer |facilities = Anvil |mat1 = Iron bar |mat1quantity = 3 |output1 = Iron kiteshield }} ==Treasure Trails== {{EmoteClue}} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Iron kiteshield}} ===Spawns=== {{ItemSpawnTableHead}} {{ItemSpawnLine|name=Iron kiteshield|location=[[Wilderness]] - south-east of [[Lava Dragon Isle]]|members=No|3247,3795,qty:1|leagueRegion=Wilderness}} {{ItemSpawnTableBottom}} ===Shop locations=== {{Store locations list|Iron kiteshield}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 21 April 2021 |update = Fishing Trawler Improvements and Equipment Rebalance: Part One |change = The shield's ranged attack bonus has been decreased from -2 to -3. }} {{Subject changes |date = 5 May 2004 |update = Bigger Banks & Treasure Trails |change = The item was graphically updated. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Iron kiteshield detail (historical).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Iron kiteshield detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Iron kiteshield (historical).png|center]] |[[File:Iron kiteshield.png|center]] |- |29 March 2004 –
